QuizGame.title: QuizGame
QuizGame.description: A classroom quiz game created by a teacher with a unique join code.

teacherId.description: UID of the teacher who owns this quiz game.

description.description: Optional short description or instructions for students.

status.description: Current game status controlling whether students can join and submit.

questionCount.description: Number of questions currently in the game.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the game was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the game was last updated.

QuizQuestion.title: QuizQuestion
QuizQuestion.description: An individual multiple-choice or open-ended question belonging to a QuizGame.

teacherId.description: Denormalized teacher UID from the parent game for rule-aligned queries.

questionType.description: Whether the question uses choice options or free-text input.

options.description: Choice options (2-6 strings for MULTIPLE_CHOICE, empty for OPEN_TEXT).

correctOptionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct option, or -1 if ungraded / open text.

orderIndex.description: Display order index within the quiz.

published.description: Whether the question is currently visible to students joining the active game.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the question was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the question was last updated.

StudentSubmission.title: StudentSubmission
StudentSubmission.description: A student's submitted profile (name and email) and answers delivered directly to the teacher.

teacherId.description: Denormalized teacher UID of the parent game.

studentUid.description: Authenticated UID of the submitting student.

studentName.description: Full name entered by the student.

studentEmail.description: Email address entered by the student.

answers.description: Map from questionId to the student's answer string.

score.description: Auto-calculated count of correct scorable multiple-choice answers.

totalScorable.description: Total number of questions in the game that have a designated correct option.

completed.description: Whether the student completed and submitted the quiz.

/games/{gameId}.description: Teacher-owned quiz games indexed by join code.

/games/{gameId}/questions/{questionId}.description: Ordered questions belonging to a quiz game.

/games/{gameId}/submissions/{studentUid}.description: Student submissions (name, email, and answers) delivered directly to the teacher.
